name: capstone
//: optionalDependencies below are a deliberate workaround, not real dependencies of this package. npm running on macOS records optional platform binaries only for the host it runs on (npm/cli#4828), so a lockfile generated on a Mac contains only the darwin-arm64 builds of the native toolchain and `npm ci` cannot build the frontend on Linux. Declaring the Linux binaries as direct optional dependencies forces npm to record them on every platform. Both architectures are listed: x64 for CI, arm64 for Docker builds on Apple Silicon (linux/arm64 is the default platform there, and frontend/Dockerfile runs `npm ci`). Each MUST stay pinned to the same version as its darwin counterpart already in the lockfile; CI asserts this. See issue #100.
